Valencia's "Space Between" — original release 1983. Valencia Tool & Die (VT&D), was a music venue and art gallery active from 1980 through 1983 in the Mission District of San Francisco, California.

evidence.recording:
2 recording notes captured

In an article in August 1982 bemoaning the lack of hardcore shows being produced on Broadway Yohannon wrote "Outside of Ruthies (probably the best venue for H.C., the "guerilla" shows remain the most true-to-form punk.

Plenty of people at this gig arranged by MDC, and the crowd was pretty friendly - no real fights (which seem to be on the decline), and a lot of women thrashing." At the end of 1982 and throughout 1983, the Tool & Die was managed by Jak's Skateboard Team member, Bill Halen aka Bill McCracken who also was one of the owners of Government Records at The Compound.
